annotation_provenance.published_process: Algorithmically pre-labelled gaze was reviewed by a paid novice/student annotator and subsequently corrected by an expert annotator.
annotation_provenance.student_expert_comparison_interpretation: annotation sensitivity, not independent human-human reliability

claim_limits: This record documents source-resolution research, not a completed Hollywood2EM source audit.
The canonical GIN distribution identifier is established by the publication and replication literature, but the exact current repository copy was not retrieved and fingerprinted here.
The CC BY 4.0 license of the article is not treated as the license of the dataset files.
A general description of the data as openly licensed does not replace exact repository-level license verification.
The student and expert labels arise from a sequential correction workflow and are not treated as independent human annotation streams.
No Hollywood2EM model-performance or cross-dataset result is created or validated by this record.
next_required_actions: Obtain an exact current copy from the canonical GIN repository or an author-verified institutional copy.
Verify the repository-level analysis-use and raw-data redistribution terms from that exact copy.
Inventory and SHA-256 fingerprint every expected ARFF file before setting source_audit_ready to true.
Verify participant and trial identities from the authoritative directory/file structure.
Verify gaze coordinate units from authoritative dataset metadata before unit-sensitive cross-dataset modelling.
Freeze student-vs-expert annotation sensitivity separately from model generalisation.
Run Lund-to-Hollywood2 and Hollywood2-to-Lund held-out modelling only after all provenance gates pass.
